newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gives rare medal to Indian actor Dilip.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gives rare medal to Indian actor Dilip.

text.p: Pakistan on Wednesday announced a rare award of its highest civil medal to a film actor of arch-rival India, Yousaf Khan, known in the film world as Dilip Kumar.

The award of the Nishan-i-Imtiaz medal to Dilip and Pakistan's top woman singer, Noor Jehan, for their services in the field of art was announced on the occasion of the golden jubilee celebrations of Pakistan's independence.
Dilip was born in the northwestern Pakistani city of Peshawar and emerged as one of the top actors in India, where he stayed on at partition of the subcontinent in 1947.
